notes.title: Update with game balance changes
notes.content:
[b]You can now select Exit from Pause during battle.

Reduced turns, enemy HP, and overall battle time.

Increased base ball speed in later stages.

Increased points (SP/Gold) that can be obtained.

Translation of previously untranslated parts.

Bug fixes.[/b]

■Creator's comment
We have adjusted the game balance based on reviews.
Increased the game speed and increased the number of
points that can be obtained to make the entire game more comfortable to play.
Adjusted to make it easier to play repeatedly.
